name: ap-sql-assistant
description: AP-SQL Assistant — Version 10.0. Introduces two major enhancements. (1) Data-type-aware Decode: the Read Only Query Builder's Decode feature now inspects the selected column's Data Type from the active schema, the selected SQL dialect, and the decode output type before generating a CASE expression, and rewrites the ELSE branch to a dialect-appropriate 'convert to text' expression (e.g. TO_CHAR for Oracle, CONVERT(VARCHAR...) for SQL Server, ::text for PostgreSQL, CAST(...AS CHAR) for MySQL) whenever the column is non-text — preventing datatype-mismatch errors like Oracle's ORA-00932 — while leaving already-text columns, columns with no schema type information, and an explicit user 'Keep original value' override completely unchanged. (2) A brand-new Error Rectifier page (added as a new, independent hamburger menu item): paste a database error and the SQL that produced it, and a new rule-based, schema-aware, dialect-aware correction engine analyzes both against the active schema and proposes a corrected SQL statement, with a plain-language explanation and a before/after 'What Changed' list. The Error Rectifier only ever analyzes and generates SQL text — it never executes SQL, never connects to a database, and never modifies the active schema. Every existing feature (Read Only Query Builder, Query Builder for CR, Schema management, Update Schema, Used Schema, Decode, Alias, Filters, Advanced Options, Selected/Described Requirements, SQL dialect selection, responsive UI, Theme, Guided Walkthrough) continues to work exactly as before.
